stage_b_v1.why: The opening is a look over the parapet: the camera rises over the frozen wire and the field opens toward the enemy line, so the first three seconds say place, cold and danger. A centred zoom on a symmetric picture only enlarges it; a rise makes the foreground wire sink against the far fog, which is the depth this picture was drawn for.
